_comment: Achievements (cooks/endgame.md 2.12, biome-void 2.23.6, cooks/build-endgame.md 2.6): 150 rows in 10 categories, 20 hidden until earned. id, name, text, cat, event (what the server watches: landmarks, hidden, pass, huntall, tameall, bosssolo, bossdeathless, belt, path100, combos, skill100, census {stat, count}, days, unmade, raidheld, escaped, portal {rank, mods}, artifactal, raid, triumph, raidal, mythic, prestige, prestige3, prestigepaths, prestigemarks, geis), params, needs (a row is live only when all of these exist: boss:<id>, biome:<id>, path:<id>, paths:<n>, skill:<id>, raid:<id>, raids:<n>, majors:<n>, pass:<poi name>, hiddenin:<biome>, minis:<belt>, mythic), hidden, title (worn from Journal > Deeds > Titles), cosmetic (Data/cosmetics.json). Rows that aren't live never show and never unlock. All first drafts.

titles._comment: Titles that don't come from an achievement row: prestige (<sworn>-sworn at 3 marks, by path), the masters' quest lines (by master id) and The Unlearning; the artifacts' Banes are WRArtifacts'.
